changes_from_browsecomp.document_pool: Each search also adds its top-1,000 document-BM25 results (k1=25, b=1) with full text to a per-question pool.
changes_from_browsecomp.pool_grep_tool: System Two tool: RE2 co-occurrence over the pooled full text (all_of, show, near, window<=300, max_docs<=40, offset); at most 8,000 characters and 5 seconds per call; one added prompt rule.
changes_from_browsecomp.jev_find_return: System Two receives the compact jev_find return (runtime/pi-serini/src/extensions/compact_find_output_v1.ts); passages, coordinates, ranking and notices are unchanged.

runtime.config: configs/browsecomp-poolgrep.json = configs/browsecomp.json plus the pool settings
runtime.switch: scripts/run.py browsecomp --pool-grep starts services/browsecomp_pool.py next to each question's document server and sets CMASS_POOL_URL
